map.输入材料、人工、机械三类要素的基期价、报告期价及权重，计算综合调差系数、调差额与: Input base-period and reporting-period prices and weights for materials, labor and machinery to compute the composite adjustment coefficient, adjustment amount and reporting-period cost.
map.调差系数 = Σ(报告期价ᵢ / 基期价ᵢ × 权重ᵢ): Adjustment coefficient = Σ(reporting priceᵢ / base priceᵢ × weightᵢ)
map.💡 公式：单项价格指数 = 报告期价 ÷ 基期价；综合调差系数 K = Σ(权重: 💡 Formula: single price index = reporting price ÷ base price; composite coefficient K = Σ(weight × price index); adjustment amount = base cost × (K − 1); reporting cost = base cost × K. Unnormalized weights auto-normalize.
map.基期价不能为0，否则该项指数视为1: Base price cannot be 0, otherwise that item's index is treated as 1
map.权重之和非1时自动按比例归一化: If weights don't sum to 1 they auto-normalize proportionally
map.调差系数大于1表示价格上涨需补差，小于1表示价格下跌: Adjustment coefficient >1 means price rose, need to pay the difference; <1 means price fell
map.📚 深度解析：工程造价价格指数调差计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Project-cost Price-index Adjustment Calculation
map.工程价款调整：施工期人工/材料/机械价格指数较基准期上涨时，按权重法调差价: Contract-price adjustment: when construction-period material/labor/machinery indices rise vs base, adjust by weight method
map.变更与签证核算：对可调差项目用调差系数 K 快速算应调金额: Change and voucher accounting: use coefficient K for adjustable items to quickly compute the amount
map.成本预警：K 持续>1 提示造价上浮，须控制采购节奏: Cost early-warning: K persistently >1 signals cost rise; control procurement pace
map.调差系数 K=材料权重×(本期材料指数÷基准材料指数)+人工权重×(本期人工指数: Adjustment coefficient K = material weight×(current material index÷base material index)+labor weight×(current labor index÷base labor index)+machinery weight×(current machinery index÷base machinery index); adjustment amount=(K−1)×base contract price; adjusted reporting price=base contract price×K. Weights must sum to 1.
map.基准合同价 100 万元，材料权重 0.55（指数 100→120）、人工权重: Base contract 1,000,000 yuan, material weight 0.55 (index 100→120), labor weight 0.30 (100→115), machinery weight 0.15 (100→110): K=0.55×1.20+0.30×1.15+0.15×1.10=1.17, adjustment amount=(1.17−1)×100=170,000 yuan, adjusted reporting price=1,170,000 yuan.
map.是的，材料/人工/机械三类权重之和应为 1（或 100%）；若漏项或超 1，K: Yes, material/labor/machinery weights should sum to 1 (or 100%); missing or exceeding 1 distorts K and the adjustment amount — verify the breakdown first.
map.K 大于 1 一定对承包方有利？: Is K>1 always good for the contractor?
map.对可调差合同，K>1 表示涨价可补偿、对承包方有利；但固定总价或不调差条款下涨价: For adjustable contracts K>1 means compensation for rise, good for the contractor; but fixed-price or no-adjustment clauses make the contractor bear the rise — K is only a reference, the contract governs.
map.工程造价调差计算器依据材料、人工、机械三类要素的基期价与报告期价及权重，按加权指: Project-cost price-adjustment calculator uses base and reporting prices and weights for materials, labor and machinery to compute the composite adjustment coefficient and amount by the weighted-index method, for settlement, contract repricing and dynamic cost management.
